reason: ACWorld defines buyer/merchant tasks over static catalogs and deterministic counterparties, with 10 integrity cases and trace reconstruction. It is a research benchmark for commerce-agent behavior; authors state it is not a production payment/security system and that its catalogs do not model live markets. No LLM inference/serving scheduling or efficiency method links it to the serving-disaggregation lineage.
title: Agentic Commerce World: An Auditable and Verifiable Environment for Vibe Commerce
